record.field: Rules for coupon steps in a marketing campaign: issuing a coupon from a loyalty programme, and which program types can be used. Load before adding a step that sends a discount, promo code or gift.

Extends section 3, ACTIVITY.
`activity_type` gains `coupon`: it issues a coupon from an existing programme and emails it out. Use it whenever the user asks to send a discount, promo code or gift - never an `email` step that merely mentions one, since that sends no code.
`loyalty_program_id` must be an existing `loyalty.program` of type `coupons`, `promo_code` or `next_order_coupons`. Other programme types cannot be issued this way.
`loyalty_mail_template_id` is a `mail.template` on `loyalty.card`, not a `mailing.mailing`.
Never invent a program. If none of the right type exists, say what is missing rather than building the campaign around a coupon that cannot be issued (R8).
